_comment: Alert rules for the cluster (ADR-039): read from the nodes' syslog, and from the mothership's HA check.

rules.name: quorum-lost
rules.title: QuorumLost
rules.summary: A Proxmox node lost cluster quorum. HA guests on it stop; repeated, the cluster resets itself.

rules.name: ha-fencing
rules.title: HaFencing
rules.match: client watchdog expired|watchdog did not stop|=> 'fence'
rules.summary: HA fencing: a node's watchdog expired or a node is being fenced (it resets).

rules.name: replication-failed
rules.title: ReplicationFailed
rules.summary: A storage replication job (pvesr) failed in two runs within the hour: the HA copy of its guest (the job's first number is the VMID) on the other node is getting stale.

rules.name: root-key-changed
rules.title: RootKeyChanged
rules._comment: One alert for the cluster-wide authorized_keys, not one per node: a sum, so an expression.
rules.summary: A key was added to or removed from root's authorized_keys on the Proxmox nodes (the line names it).

rules.name: ha-stuck
rules.title: HaStuck
rules._comment: check-ha-health runs on the mothership and logs there.
rules.summary: HA is not where it should be: a node is held in maintenance mode (its HA guests stay elsewhere) or an HA service is stuck migrating. The line says which and how to clear it.
